info.name: Playwright Automation - Account Registration
info.description: Positive and negative API tests for POST /api/auth/register. The endpoint writes to the real users table. Run the requests in order using Collection Runner: successful registration, duplicate email, then missing required fields. Use only a test account/email you control.

exec: // Generate a unique email each time this request runs so the test can be repeated.
pm.test('returns a non-empty JSON response', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('object').that.is.not.empty; });

request.description: Creates a real account. The request generates a unique email and saves it for the duplicate-email case.

item.name: Negative - register the same email again (409)

exec: pm.test('returns 409 Conflict for an existing email', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });

pm.test('responds with JSON error details', function () { pm.response.to.have.header('Content-Type'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/json'); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('object').that.is.not.empty; });

request.description: Uses the email created by the first request. Run after the positive case in Collection Runner.

exec: pm.test('responds with JSON validation details', function () { pm.response.to.have.header('Content-Type'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/json'); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('object').that.is.not.empty; });

request.description: Omits first name, last name, and password to exercise required-field validation.
